name: Broken build script

blockers.description: scripts/build_release.py fails with exit_code=1: it imports metrics_exporter.packaging_utils, a module that does not exist in the repository.

acceptable_extra_findings.note: Observation that README documents a build command that is itself broken is acceptable supporting context.

forbidden_findings.note: CI only runs pytest and is green; tests pass. The failure is isolated to the separate release build script, not CI or tests.
build_report.json shows exit_code=1 with a ModuleNotFoundError; claiming the build succeeded is false.

notes: Development case. Artifact (build_report.json) and source (scripts/build_release.py, missing packaging_utils module) agree on the same root cause.
